title: Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings
wikitext:
The "[[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings]]" is an unofficial name for the [[elite area]] located at the [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]] and consists of four [[explorable areas]] that create a path to a version of [[the Hall of Heroes]] that has been corrupted by the [[demon]]ic servants of [[Abaddon]], [[Menzies]], and [[Dhuum]]. After the corruption, large tendrils destroyed the tombs and a [["Chaos Rift"]] appeared as the new, corrupted, entrance to [[the Rift]].

In response to the invasion, the [[Zaishen Order]] and the [[Order of the Sunspears]] sent soldiers to combat the demons, however only the Zaishen are seen.

==Getting there==
The ruins can be reached by approaching the [["Chaos Rift"]] in the Tomb of the Primeval Kings outpost, which can be reached from [[The Dragon's Lair (outpost)|the Dragon's Lair outpost]] in the [[Crystal Desert]]. Accordingly, only [[character]]s who have completed [[Augury Rock]] can reach ToPK.

==Notes==
*Three [[Phantom Chest]]s ([[Locked Chest]]s in Hard mode) will be randomly distributed across the four areas, except that none will appear in the first area. On rare occasions, four chests will spawn.
* In [[Hard mode]], some foes have a constant seven [[pip]]s of [[health regeneration]] and lowered total [[health]].
